examples: Try an animated theme without letting unknown code run until you agree.
how_to: Select an installed theme that ships a script on the themes screen; its details say it runs effects.js and that you will be asked before it runs.
Set it as the global theme (or double click it). The first time, the app asks: never, allow once or always allow.
Always allow covers that exact script on every device; allow once lasts until you reload; never applies everywhere too. Declining still applies the theme without the animation.
